function: RIS phase-shift control by DQN agents, plus modulation-stream assignment of semantic parts and RIS-row usage allocation, driven by user-requirement rewards (pp. 4-5).
system: RIS-assisted MIMO-OFDM, 2x2 (4x4 for two users), passive reflecting RIS UPAs (up to two), 1024 subcarriers; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 2, 5, 8).
method: Deep Q-network agents (dense layers) trained offline with 1280 images then fine-tuned online from known images; supervised SENet semantic encoder-decoder and UNet segmentation (pp. 6-7).
data_channel: Own simulated Rician MIMO-OFDM channel, LoS/NLoS power ratio 10, random user movement in 10x10 area, blocked or ideal; OxfordPets and CamVid images (pp. 8-9).
test_conditions: Transceiver trained over AWGN at 10 dB (p. 6), tested on RIS Rician MIMO-OFDM, ideal or blocked, 3 and 10 dB; agents fine-tuned online (pp. 7-9).
baselines: Non-learned: JPEG+LDPC coding; learned: MAB-based RIS control [23], conventional DQN with sum-rate reward (RL-Rate), no-RIS cases (pp. 9-10).
metrics: Object classification accuracy (ACC), image MSE, average number of RIS rows used (pp. 6, 9-11).
q1_support: p. 8: "the Rician channel model is employed with a delay spread of" - custom Rician MIMO-OFDM simulator (LoS plus complex Gaussian NLoS); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 7: "agents are finetuned to adapt to changing channel environment" - also the transceiver is trained over AWGN at 10 dB (page 6) and tested on blocked or ideal Rician RIS MIMO-OFDM channels at 3 and 10 dB (pages 8-9); user requirements change online in Fig. 10 (page 11).
q3_support: p. 9: "multi-armed bandit (MAB) [23], and other conventional methods such as JPEG+LDPC coding" - Table I compares RIS-SC with RL-Rate, MAB [23] (earlier learned RIS control) and JPEG+LDPC (non-learned) on ACC and MSE; the JPEG+LDPC column is labelled (MAB).
q4_support: p. 3: "its low time consumption and fast convergence during online" - qualitative remark on DQN; no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime is reported for the proposed method.
q5_support: p. 9: "The OxfordPets dataset [34] is used" - public image datasets of the learning task (OxfordPets, CamVid) over a simulated channel; no link or release statement for code or channel data anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included because the DQN agents configure the RIS phase shifts (area 3); the semantic JSCC transceiver around them is trained separately and fixed. The JPEG+LDPC column of Table I is labelled (MAB), so its RIS control is still learned and the only fully non-learned comparators are JPEG+LDPC coding and the no-RIS cases; the reviewer may want to confirm q3. q2 rests on the AWGN-trained transceiver tested on Rician RIS channels and on the reported online fine-tuning to changing channels and requirements.
